results.name: People on the Move: Heather Getz Joins TELA Bio as Chief Executive Officer | BioBuzz
results.content:
[TELA Bio, Inc.](https://www.telabio.com/), a Malvern, Pennsylvania-based commercial-stage medical technology company focused on innovative soft-tissue reconstruction solutions, has [announced the appointment of Heather Getz](https://ir.telabio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tela-bio-announces-appointment-heather-getz-chief-executive) as Chief Executive Officer and Director, effective August 4, 2026. Getz succeeds company co-founder Antony Koblish, who is stepping down after leading TELA Bio through the development and commercialization of its OviTex™ soft-tissue reconstruction portfolio.
Announcing her appointment, [Getz said](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hgetz_tela-bio-announces-appointment-of-heather-activity-7490732759347462144-xYhn/): “I am honored to join TELA Bio at such an exciting time in the Company’s evolution. TELA Bio has built a differentiated portfolio, a strong commercial foundation, and a clear commitment to improving outcomes for patients and surgeons. I am excited to partner with our talented employees, leadership team, customers, and Board to build on that momentum, accelerate commercial execution, strengthen customer relationships, and expand our impact.”
## **About TELA Bio**  
TELA Bio, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company focused on providing innovative technologies that optimize clinical outcomes by prioritizing the preservation and restoration of the patient’s own anatomy. The company is committed to providing surgeons with advanced, economically effective soft-tissue reconstruction solutions that leverage the patient’s natural healing response while minimizing long-term exposure to permanent synthetic materials. TELA Bio’s flagship OviTex product line has helped establish the company as a leader in soft-tissue reconstruction since its founding by [Antony Koblish.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/antony-koblish-28515643/) More information is available at [www.telabio.com](https://www.telabio.com/).
